scope: static local registry lifecycle review only

registryOwner.summary: Demo stores entities by index and class indexes. getEntity returns null when the index slot is undefined; deleteEntity clears the index slot; registerEntity overwrites any previous entity at that index.

entityLifecycleStatesObservedByParser.semanticLimitation: Does not prove the entity never existed in game or stream.

entityLifecycleStatesObservedByParser.meaningInLocalCode: Entity exists in registry and entity.active is true.
entityLifecycleStatesObservedByParser.semanticLimitation: Active is local registry state, not a game semantic claim.

entityLifecycleStatesObservedByParser.meaningInLocalCode: Entity exists in registry and entity.active is false after local deactivation.
entityLifecycleStatesObservedByParser.semanticLimitation: Inactive does not prove destruction, death, leave semantics, or objective completion.

entityLifecycleStatesObservedByParser.meaningInLocalCode: handleSvcPacketEntities returned a CREATE event, and registration is deferred until DemoEntityHandler applies it.
entityLifecycleStatesObservedByParser.semanticLimitation: Requires event application ordering to be understood before making registry-history claims.

entityLifecycleStatesObservedByParser.meaningInLocalCode: handleSvcPacketEntities returned a DELETE event instead of deleting directly.
entityLifecycleStatesObservedByParser.semanticLimitation: Does not prove removal until DemoEntityHandler applies the event.

registrationPaths.ordering: registerEntity before payload move or extractor skip
handleSvcPacketEntities emits CREATE event, then DemoEntityHandler registers and applies batch later

missingEntityInvariant.UPDATE: getEntity(index) must be non-null or the parser throws Unable to find an entity with index.
missingEntityInvariant.LEAVE: getEntity(index) must be non-null and active or the parser throws.
missingEntityInvariant.DELETE: getEntity(index) must be non-null and active or the parser throws.
missingEntityInvariant.CREATE: does not require prior missing state; registerEntity overwrites any previous entity at the same index.

doesNotObserve: game truth outside local parser interpretation
